projects.name: Clothify Shopping Application
projects.technologies: Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS
bullets: Designed and built an e-commerce platform using microservices architecture following SOLID principles, with clean RESTful API contracts enabling independent development and deployment across services.

Implemented the SAGA pattern with event-driven architecture (Kafka) to manage distributed transactions across Order, Payment, and Inventory services — ensuring data consistency via compensating transactions on failure (e.g., automatic inventory rollback if payment fails).
Engineered fault-tolerant inter-service communication using Feign Client with the Circuit Breaker pattern, preventing cascading failures during service outages and improving system resilience.
Optimized performance by integrating Redis for in-memory caching to reduce response latency, with Kafka enabling asynchronous, decoupled communication between services.
Containerized with Docker and orchestrated via Kubernetes; deployed on AWS with API Gateway and Load Balancing for scalability under variable traffic.
